NOTION-MANAGEMENT SKILL STRUCTURE
==================================

📋 SKILL.md (Main Entry Point)
├── Name: notion-management
├── Description: Complete guide for Notion API in Node.js/JavaScript
├── Quick Start: Common operations (fetch, create, update)
├── Property Types Reference: All supported types and formats
├── Database Operations: Create, update, fetch databases
├── Content Guidelines: Markdown, toggles, rich text
├── Search and Navigation: Finding pages and users
├── Error Handling: Common errors and solutions
├── Best Practices: 8 key patterns
└── Advanced Patterns: Link to advanced-patterns.md

📁 references/ (Detailed Documentation)
├── advanced-patterns.md
│   ├── Batch Operations
│   ├── Data Synchronization
│   ├── Database Relationships
│   ├── Performance Optimization
│   ├── Error Recovery
│   └── Complex Content Management
│
├── examples.md
│   ├── Creating Databases
│   ├── Creating Pages
│   ├── Fetching Content
│   ├── Syncing External APIs
│   ├── Project Templates
│   ├── Searching
│   ├── Error Handling Patterns
│   └── Building Documents Programmatically
│
└── troubleshooting.md
    ├── Property Validation Errors (multi_select, dates, checkboxes)
    ├── Database Schema Issues (property names, data_source_id)
    ├── Content Issues (toggles, markdown, links)
    ├── Permission Errors
    ├── Performance & Rate Limits
    └── Quick Reference Table

📁 scripts/ (Utilities)
└── validate-properties.ts
    ├── Validates page properties against database schema
    ├── Catches errors before sending to Notion API
    ├── Checks types, options, dates, special formats
    └── Usage: pnpm dlx tsx scripts/validate-properties.ts <db-id> '<json>'

KEY DESIGN DECISIONS
====================

1. Progressive Disclosure
   - SKILL.md: Core workflows, quick start, best practices (~500 lines)
   - references/: Detailed guides loaded only when needed
   - scripts/: Utilities for validation and automation

2. Multi-Select Limitation Documented
   - API doesn't support multiple options in single call
   - Documented workaround: use separate updates or multiple pages
   - Examples show correct pattern

3. Expanded Property Formats Emphasized
   - Date: date:PropertyName:start, date:PropertyName:end, date:PropertyName:is_datetime
   - Place: place:PropertyName:name, place:PropertyName:address, etc.
   - Special names: userDefined:id, userDefined:url
   - Multiple examples and error cases shown

4. Toggle/Collapsible Content Documented
   - Clear syntax with tab indentation
   - Common mistakes highlighted
   - Examples in multiple references

5. Error-Driven Documentation
   - Troubleshooting guide focuses on real error messages
   - Each error includes: causes, solutions, code examples
   - Quick reference table at end

WHEN THIS SKILL ACTIVATES
=========================

Claude loads this skill when user asks about:
- Creating Notion pages or databases
- Managing Notion content or properties
- Working with Notion API in Node.js/JavaScript
- Debugging Notion API errors
- Setting up Notion automation/syncing
- Complex Notion workflows

KNOWN LIMITATIONS & DOCUMENTED
==============================

1. Multi-select: Can only pass single option (API limitation, documented)
2. No batch database schema updates: Must be sequential (documented in troubleshooting)
3. Toggles require specific indentation: Must use tabs (documented with examples)
4. Rate limits: Must add delays between batch operations (documented with code)

LEARNING FROM ERRORS
====================

This skill was created after experiencing these errors:
✓ "Invalid multi_select value" - Now documented with solutions
✓ Wrong multi_select format (arrays, commas) - Now shows correct usage
✓ Missing date:Property:start format - Now prominent in reference
✓ Toggle indentation issues - Now clear syntax and examples
✓ Data source vs database ID confusion - Now explained with examples

The skill turned these hard-learned lessons into documented knowledge.
